author: Claude (Cloudreach Meshy generation worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 5 m diameter, 14 m tall incl. conical roof

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Round stone tower house, 5 metres in diameter and 14 metres tall, built of coursed pale weathered limestone blocks with a few horizontal string courses. Conical slate-blue tiled roof with a small gold finial. Several pointed-arch windows with warm amber glowing glass panes. A royal-blue fabric banner with a gold trim and pale wing emblem hanging from a gold bracket on one side. Wooden door at the base. Matches the tower, arch window and banner references. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.

visual_verdict: Strong: round coursed-limestone tower, conical slate-blue roof with gold finial and dormers, arched amber windows, blue wing banner on gold bracket; 6.6 m wide incl. banner, 14 m tall. Single material.
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
